diagnostics.message: this closure writes `total`, which it captures, and `par_each_mut` runs it on several workers at once
notes: workers that write `total` at the same time would race; a parallel closure writes only its own element (§6.12)
to combine a value from each element, compute it in the closure and combine them with `par_map_reduce`
diagnostics.title: a parallel closure that writes data it captures
